items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection
items.rationale: Frost fracture of an internal fitting is covered under 2.4.4/7.1.9, and leak location is covered under 2.4.6/5.2.2 (cap EUR 2,500). The combined line is indemnified at a fair market price for the fitting repair plus thermal-imaging detection.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint)
items.rationale: The damage is frost acting on the external surface from without. The optional peril 2.1(d) is not shown as agreed, so 3.5, 3.1.5 and 7.1.13 exclude the whole combined line.
